extracted.intended_audience: General readers, students, and researchers interested in the history of censorship and freedom of expression in Czechoslovakia/Czech Republic
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic Wikipedia article summarizing the history and practices of censorship in Czechoslovakia, covering the Nazi occupation, communist-era controls (including self-censorship), cultural restrictions on literature, music, film, and the end of censorship following the Velvet Revolution and democratization.
